function.name: version_api_VersionApi_get_version
function.description: Retrieve the current version of the application, including its name and version number in a simple JSON object format. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_get_project_by_name_and_version
function.description: Retrieve the details of a specific project using its unique name and version identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The unique name of the project to be retrieved.

version.description: The specific version of the project to be retrieved, formatted as 'major.minor.patch' (e.g., '1.2.0').

function.name: project_api_ProjectApi_update_project
function.description: Updates the existing project details with the provided information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project to update.

name.description: The new name of the project.

status.description: The new status of the project.

start_date.description: The start date of the project in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date of the project in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional, can be null if the project is ongoing.

budget.description: The updated budget for the project in USD. This is a float type value.

project_data.description: A dictionary containing the updated project details.
